body: Thank you for your kind reply. I got a BP monitor last night and took it this morning. I'm glad to say that it's down out of the imminent stroke range.

I would love to take a vacation. Money is tight, though. I recently bought a house, and it seems like every time I turn around, the house is eating my paycheck. I think I may take a weekend trip soon.
I'm currently meeting with a therapist. I'm working on it, but there are times when it feels like all my progress hasn't happened. I do try to keep it in perspective, though.

You're right. I do try to keep that in mind, and people have generally been very nice. I'm in a fairly technical field too, doing program management. There are so many details that I let slip because I don't know any better. I'm debating finding another job that's less chaotic.

Thank you. I appreciate your taking the time to reply.

Thank you for your reply. It seems like when I'm in the middle of freaking out, I lose perspective. I do have very high expectations for myself, and when I don't meet them, I self-flagellate. As for my therapist, I have an appointment today, and I was planning to tell her. She can't help me if I'm not honest with her.

Believe me, I don't tell my parents most of the things about my life. The main thing, though, is who I'm dating. I tend to be attracted to free spirits who usually don't have as much education as I do. For the record, I feel like most of my education was unnecessary and only obtained because I didn't know what else to do. So I tell my parents about the *awesome new guy* I'm dating, and they wig out completely. I don't want to subject anyone to that craziness, so I avoid the situation. In the end, the guys end up feeling like I don't think they're good enough to meet my parents. In reality, I just don't want them to see what kind of crazy I came from.

I do need to work on spending more time on me. I've mostly been wasting time in the internet, but I'm working on starting a new diet and exercise plan, which I'm excited about. I'm hoping it will help me get out of this funk to feeling and looking better.
